info.name: Ocean - Swap Deals (Simplified)
info.description: Comprehensive swap deal system where sellers list products for swap with complete details (condition, preferred swap category, subcategories, swap conditions) and buyers propose swaps. Only swap deal creation is subscription-gated, proposals are unlimited. Matches Flutter frontend form fields exactly.

request.description:
Create a new swap deal listing with image uploads (subscription gated). Sellers provide complete product details including condition, preferred swap category, subcategories, and swap conditions. Images are uploaded to Cloudinary and stored as JSON array.

**Required Fields:**
- productToSwap: Name of product
- categoryToSwap: Product category
- condition: New, Like New, Good, Fair, Poor
- description: Product description
- preferredSwapCategory: What category to swap with
- swapConditions: Swap preferences
- images: 2-4 product images

**Optional Fields:**
- brandToSwap: Product brand
- preferredSwapSubcategories: JSON array of subcategories
